title: Actor
description: A first-class participant in Tessera. Either a human or an AI agent. The schema-level distinction (kind) is one of the core Tessera ideas: agents are not users-with-a-flag.

id.description: Stable across sessions. UUIDv7 recommended for time-ordering.

kind.description: Schema-level distinction. Humans and agents have different lifecycle semantics.

agent_runtime.description: For agents: identifies the runtime, e.g. 'claude-code', 'cursor', 'devin', 'manus'. NULL for humans.

parent_actor_id.description: For agents: the human actor who spawned this agent session. NULL for humans. Lets clients trace agent activity back to a responsible human.
